combat_retreat_hp.name: Combat Retreat HP (%)
combat_retreat_hp.desc: Retreats during a fight when HP is below this value. Higher = retreats earlier.

line_chase_retreat_hp.name: Lane/Chase Instant Retreat HP (%)
line_chase_retreat_hp.desc: Retreats immediately during laning or a chase when HP is at or below this value.

line_chase_target_guard_hp.name: Chase Target Hold HP (%)
line_chase_target_guard_hp.desc: Drops the chased target when HP is at or below this value.

lane_retreat_final.name: Lane Retreat Score Threshold
lane_retreat_final.desc: Retreats when the final lane retreat score exceeds this value. Lower = retreats more easily.

crowd_retreat_weight.name: Outnumbered Retreat Weight
crowd_retreat_weight.desc: Weight given toward retreating when enemies outnumber allies by 2 or more.

combat_avoid_hp.name: Fight Avoidance HP (%)
combat_avoid_hp.desc: Avoids fights when HP is below this value.

combat_avoid_count_margin.name: Fight Avoidance Margin (players)
combat_avoid_count_margin.desc: Avoids a fight when enemies outnumber allies by this many. Lower = more cautious.

self_risk_ignore_hp.name: Ignore Danger HP (%)
self_risk_ignore_hp.desc: At or above this HP, acts while ignoring nearby danger.

jg_gank_hp_start.name: Gank Start HP (%)
jg_gank_hp_start.desc: The jungler starts a gank when at or above this HP.

jg_gank_hp_floor.name: Gank Minimum HP (%)
jg_gank_hp_floor.desc: Stops ganking when HP drops below this value mid-gank.

gank_abort_hp.name: Gank Abort HP (%)
gank_abort_hp.desc: Abandons an ongoing gank when HP is below this value.

gank_abort_tower.name: Abort Gank Under Enemy Tower
gank_abort_tower.desc: When off, keeps ganking even near an enemy tower.

gank_call_accept_hp.name: Gank Call Accept Min HP (%)
gank_call_accept_hp.desc: HP needed to accept a gank call while on a lane plan. Also applies to the jungler when on a lane plan.

jungle_safe_radius.name: Jungle Camp Safety Radius
jungle_safe_radius.desc: Enemy laners and supports within this distance of a camp are treated as a threat.

jungle_stop_hp.name: Stop Jungling HP (%)
jungle_stop_hp.desc: The jungler stops jungling when HP is below this value.

minion_damage_ratio.name: Minion Damage Sensitivity (%)
minion_damage_ratio.desc: Treats it as danger when the expected minion damage rate exceeds this value. Lower = more cautious.

lane_assign_hp.name: Lane Assignment HP (%)
lane_assign_hp.desc: HP threshold for Top, Mid and Bottom candidates. Jungle and Support are excluded by the game default rules.

lane_opportunity_own_min.name: Lane Opportunity Min Allies (players)
lane_opportunity_own_min.desc: Needs at least this many healthy allies in the lane area to treat it as an opportunity.

support_minion_block.name: No Lane Minions for Support
support_minion_block.desc: When off, the Support also clears lane minions.

bot_duo_partner.name: Bottom-Support Duo Check
bot_duo_partner.desc: When off, Bottom and Support move alone without their partner.

liner_roam_self_hp.name: Roam Min Own HP (%)
liner_roam_self_hp.desc: Laners roam only when at or above this HP.

liner_roam_lane_healthy_hp.name: Roam Target Lane: Healthy Ally HP (%)
liner_roam_lane_healthy_hp.desc: When choosing a lane to roam to, allies at or above this HP count as healthy.

liner_roam_call_chance.name: Roam Team Call Chance (/1000)
liner_roam_call_chance.desc: Chance of sending a team call when roaming.

hazard_avoid_padding.name: Danger Zone Walk-Around Margin
hazard_avoid_padding.desc: Walks around danger zones with this much extra clearance.

push_sustain_min_healthy.name: Push Sustain Min Allies (players)
push_sustain_min_healthy.desc: An ongoing push continues only with at least this many healthy allies.

push_sustain_margin.name: Push Sustain Margin (players)
push_sustain_margin.desc: Keeps pushing only when allies outnumber enemies by this many.

tower_chase_own_hp.name: Under-Tower Chase Own HP (%)
tower_chase_own_hp.desc: Own HP needed to chase under an enemy tower (moves the 25/35/45 steps together).

base_defense_min_enemies.name: Base Defense Trigger Enemy Count
base_defense_min_enemies.desc: Goes to defend when this many or more enemies (minions likely included) are near the base.

base_defense_hold_retreat_hp.name: Base Defense Retreat HP (%)
base_defense_hold_retreat_hp.desc: Backs off while defending the base when HP is below this value.

base_defense_hold_nexus_hp.name: Relic Danger HP (%)
base_defense_hold_nexus_hp.desc: When Relic HP is at or below this value, stands ground unless facing lethal damage.

base_defense_hold_dmg_ratio.name: Base Defense Damage Rate Threshold (%)
base_defense_hold_dmg_ratio.desc: When the damage rate taken exceeds this value, treats it as danger regardless of HP.

lowhp_ult_bonus_low.name: Low HP Ultimate Bonus
lowhp_ult_bonus_low.desc: Added to the Ultimate usage score when HP is below 45%.

gank_call_rng.name: Gank Call Accept Roll
gank_call_rng.desc: Applies only when the evaluation is negative. Higher = harder to accept calls.

pickoff_hp_bands.name: Pick-off Low HP Threshold (%)
pickoff_hp_bands.desc: Adjusts the lower HP threshold and the one 20 above it together. Higher = also prioritizes healthier enemies.

structure_retreat_keep_hp.name: Structure Attack Retreat Hold HP (%)
structure_retreat_keep_hp.desc: When hitting an enemy structure during a chase with a retreat already requested, keeps that request at or below this HP.

pre_gank_engage_profile.name: Lane Engage Before Gank Arrives
pre_gank_engage_profile.desc: 100 = game default HP35, range 200000. Higher = engages more readily. 0.7.2+: needs a visible enemy champion near (Gank Enemy Check Range).

gank_travel_deadline.name: Jungle Gank Travel Deadline
gank_travel_deadline.desc: Uses the same seconds for the jungle gank plan deadline and the travel-time approval threshold.

battle_call_response_seconds.name: Fight Call Response Time
battle_call_response_seconds.desc: Aligns the response seconds for arrival approval and diagnostics. The separate 6s Ultimate floor is kept.

objective_power_allowance.name: Objective Strength Allowance
objective_power_allowance.desc: Margin added to the allies' total HP. Higher = looser conditions to go in.

same_lane_gank_retry_seconds.name: Same Lane Gank Retry
same_lane_gank_retry_seconds.desc: Extra seconds that block a retry on the same lane. The time logged for stats is unchanged.

chase_speed_ratio.name: Chase Speed Ratio (tenths)
chase_speed_ratio.desc: Compares enemy move speed x10 with own speed x this value. Lower = stops chasing more easily over speed gaps.

tower_tank_hits.name: Tower Tanking HP (hits)
tower_tank_hits.desc: Picks allies with enough HP to take this many tower hits as tank candidates. Team-wide. Lower = takes more risk.

kill_bonus_cap.name: Kill Bonus Cap
kill_bonus_cap.desc: Cap on the bonus for the chance to kill an enemy. Higher = prioritizes finishing attacks and skills.

ally_spacing_radius.name: Ally Spacing Radius
ally_spacing_radius.desc: Radius nearby allies keep between each other. Higher = stand farther apart.

near_ally_link_margin.name: Nearby Ally Combo Range Margin
near_ally_link_margin.desc: Extra distance beyond an ally's attack range still counted as able to combo. Higher = coordinates over a wider area.

line_defense_approval_profile.name: Lane Defense Approval Caution
line_defense_approval_profile.desc: 100 = risk 35, long-term score 25, short-term score 10. Higher = stricter approval.

base_battle_call_range.name: Base Fight Call Allowance
base_battle_call_range.desc: Allowed band of a random roll out of 1000. Separate from approval of the base assist plan itself.

shared_battle_role_markers.name: Fight Reference Role Markers
shared_battle_role_markers.desc: Threshold for the total of arrival role markers on both teams. Not a count of same-team votes.

basic_trade_hp_divisor.name: Basic Attack Trade HP Margin (divisor)
basic_trade_hp_divisor.desc: Safe when HP is above own max HP / this value plus enemy basic attack damage. Higher = trades more aggressively.

support_cap_multiplier.name: Heal/Shield Value Multiplier
support_cap_multiplier.desc: Heals count up to lost HP + damage estimate x this value; shields up to damage estimate x (this value+1). Actual amounts unchanged.

buff_arrival_value_seconds.name: Support Skill Arrival Window (s)
buff_arrival_value_seconds.desc: Lowers the value of slow-arriving support skills over this period. Higher = values late arrivals more.

push_start_base.name: Push Start Base Score
push_start_base.desc: Start threshold before stat adjustments. Higher = requires a higher score.

other_lane_collapse_profile.name: Other Lane Collapse Alert
other_lane_collapse_profile.desc: Adjusts other-lane metrics and stage thresholds together. Higher = gives up pushes earlier.

gank_reevaluate_seconds.name: Jungle Gank Re-evaluation Interval
gank_reevaluate_seconds.desc: Re-evaluations sooner than this many seconds are put on hold, as in the game default.

gank_candidate_margin.name: Gank Candidate Count Margin
gank_candidate_margin.desc: Extra margin on the number of enemy candidates allowed when there are allied candidates.

ambush_engage_radius.name: Ambush Target Radius
ambush_engage_radius.desc: Radius for scanning enemy candidates during an ambush check. Vision and recent-sighting conditions are kept.

objective_lane_pressure_profile.name: Pre-Objective Lane Pressure Threshold
objective_lane_pressure_profile.desc: Adjusts lane stage, metric and headcount thresholds together. Higher = more lane pressure candidates.

roam_retry_extra_seconds.name: Roam Retry Extra Interval
roam_retry_extra_seconds.desc: Seconds added to the default interval. Skipped when there is no record of a last roam.

defense_leave_hp.name: Defense Plan Leave HP (%)
defense_leave_hp.desc: HP threshold for normal defense. The threat path uses 10 below this value.

structure_skill_bonus.name: Structure Skill Candidate Bonus
structure_skill_bonus.desc: Bonus only to the first two skill scores aimed at type 4 structures in the Relic attack plan.

epic_final_allies_min.name: Epic Final Ally Count Threshold
epic_final_allies_min.desc: Headcount threshold after jitter adjustment. The enemy-adjustment-0 exception and pre-approval are kept.

boss_respawn_wait_seconds.name: Boss Respawn Wait (s)
boss_respawn_wait_seconds.desc: With no boss up, ends the plan if the remaining respawn time is longer than this value.

boss_reposition_improvement.name: Boss Hunt Reposition Gain
boss_reposition_improvement.desc: Score improvement required for a local reposition. The existing distance fallback condition is kept.

boss_poke_damage_factor.name: Boss Poke Damage Weight
boss_poke_damage_factor.desc: Multiplier for comparing expected damage with HP. Higher = more conservative risk judgment.

active_recall_slack_profile.name: Finish Strategy Recall End Slack (s)
active_recall_slack_profile.desc: Strategy 0 uses the chosen seconds, strategy 1 uses 1s less. Only adjusts the large-plan end check.

position_isolation_risk_percent.name: Isolated Position Risk Bonus (%)
position_isolation_risk_percent.desc: Position risk added with no allies nearby and 2+ enemies. Higher = avoids going in alone.

front_ally_risk_scale.name: Stay Behind Tanky Allies (%)
front_ally_risk_scale.desc: Scales the risk score for standing ahead of tanky allies and its two caps together. Higher = tries to stand behind allies.

battle_skill_safety_margin.name: Fight Skill Safety Margin
battle_skill_safety_margin.desc: Safety margin added to skill range in chases and fights. Higher = safe spots are farther away. Out-of-vision cap keeps default rules.

wave_position_risk_divisor.name: Wave Position Risk Discount (divisor)
wave_position_risk_divisor.desc: Divides position risk by this value when the default wave safety condition is met. Higher = sees areas near the wave as safer.

movement_skill_period_margin.name: Mobility Skill Saving Margin (updates)
movement_skill_period_margin.desc: Margin added when comparing walk time with skill cycle in mobility-saving mode. Not in seconds. Higher = saves mobility skills more.

early_gank_target_min_hp.name: Early Gank Target Min HP
early_gank_target_min_hp.desc: Minimum HP of an enemy considered as an early gank target. Different from the low-HP preference setting.

camp_time_margin_profile.name: Camp Contest Time Margin (%)
camp_time_margin_profile.desc: Scales the 1s survival margin and the 0.5s margin for comparing enemy clear time by the same ratio.

battle_risk_retreat_threshold.name: Fight Risk Retreat Threshold
battle_risk_retreat_threshold.desc: Adjusts position risk K/2.4K and direct damage estimate ratio 2K together. Lower = retreats at smaller risks.

unseen_self_risk_divisor.name: Unseen Self-Risk Discount (divisor)
unseen_self_risk_divisor.desc: Divides base self-risk by this value when unseen by enemies. Other risk bonuses stay. Higher = trusts staying hidden more.

battle_reposition_distance_scale.name: Fight Reposition Distance Range (%)
battle_reposition_distance_scale.desc: Scales the 5 reposition candidate distances around enemies and self. Higher = searches a wider distance band.

candidate_move_budget_margin.name: Attack/Skill Search Move Margin
candidate_move_budget_margin.desc: Adds move budget x this value when gathering basic attack and first two skill candidates. Real range/effect caps kept. Not seconds.

forward_damage_credit_percent.name: Advance Damage Offset (%)
forward_damage_credit_percent.desc: Subtracts this share of current-position damage from post-move risk, floored at 0. Higher = sees advancing as less risky.

battle_move_candidate_penalty.name: Fight Move Candidate Penalty
battle_move_candidate_penalty.desc: Penalty only for move candidates that meet the default conditions. Higher = picks moves less often vs attacks and skills.

lane_attack_move_allowance.name: Lane Attack Approach Margin
lane_attack_move_allowance.desc: Approach margin multiplied into own move budget. Higher = also considers farther attack candidates.

lane_defense_support_margin.name: Lane Defense Assist Margin
lane_defense_support_margin.desc: Assist margin added to the number of other allies nearby. The default ability conditions are still required.

lane_exchange_advantage_ticks.name: Lane Trade Time Advantage
lane_exchange_advantage_ticks.desc: Trade time-gap threshold for the final lane candidate. In update ticks. The separate headcount bypass is kept.

lane_superiority_profile.name: Lane Numbers Advantage Caution
lane_superiority_profile.desc: Low: assigned HP 20, 1 player. Default: 25, 2 players. High: 30, 3 players. Team-wide policy.

lane_call_travel_seconds.name: Lane Gank Call Travel Limit
lane_call_travel_seconds.desc: Applies the same seconds to the call-response travel cost cap and the accepted plan deadline.

mia_notice_caution_profile.name: MIA Alert Caution
mia_notice_caution_profile.desc: 100 = wait 1/4s, remembered HP 60, distance 170000. Higher = waits longer and filters more strictly.

relay_undying_limit_centiseconds.name: Ops Signal Undying Time Left
relay_undying_limit_centiseconds.desc: 100 = game default 1s. Remaining-undying threshold in 0.01s units; once passed, the existing plan is released.

gank_lane_tower_wave_profile.name: Gank Target Tower/Wave Caution
gank_lane_tower_wave_profile.desc: Adjusts tower radius, minion gap and wave position filters together. Higher = more conservative.

lane_wait_front_minion_distance.name: Lead Ally Minion Wait Distance
lane_wait_front_minion_distance.desc: Uses the same distance for the approach check against the lead allied minion and for the back-off distance.

support_roam_adc_min_hp.name: Support Roam Bottom Min HP
support_roam_adc_min_hp.desc: Threshold for checking the allied Bottom's HP on the three known Support roam paths.

purchase_recall_walk_ticks.name: Shopping Recall Walk Time
purchase_recall_walk_ticks.desc: Walk-time threshold for recalling to buy items. Higher = allows longer walks back. Not in seconds.

purchase_recall_threat_radius.name: Shopping Recall Threat Radius
purchase_recall_threat_radius.desc: Radius in which enemies count as threats for a shopping recall. Higher = watches farther enemies. Default distance/activity rules kept.

purchase_recall_threat_memory.name: Shopping Recall Threat Memory
purchase_recall_threat_memory.desc: How long recently seen enemies are remembered as threats for a shopping recall. Higher = remembers longer. Not in seconds.

same_lane_partner_radius.name: Same Lane Partner Radius
same_lane_partner_radius.desc: Radius in which a same-lane teammate counts as nearby. Higher = counts farther teammates. Separate out-of-range approval is kept.

support_zero_net_penalty.name: Assist Zero Net Score Penalty
support_zero_net_penalty.desc: Penalty when the assist score, after meeting eligibility and subtracting travel cost, is exactly 0. Higher = picks that assist less.

camp_deadline_arrival_seconds.name: Normal Camp Deadline Arrival Margin
camp_deadline_arrival_seconds.desc: Extra time (s) added when comparing a normal camp's deadline with arrival time. Higher = stricter about arriving in time.

enemy_base_allies_radius.name: All Allies Near Enemy Base Radius
enemy_base_allies_radius.desc: Radius for judging whether all present allies are near the enemy base. Uses the deciding player's setting. Higher = counts more widely.

ambush_wait_accept_radius.name: Ambush Wait Radius
ambush_wait_accept_radius.desc: Radius, within the default position rules for ambush start/recheck, where waiting counts. Higher = wider. Enemy detection radius kept.

tracked_target_chase_bonus.name: Tracked Target Out-of-Range Chase Bonus
tracked_target_chase_bonus.desc: Score added to chase candidates when the registered tracked target is out of range. Higher = chases that target more.

champion_ultimate_waste_penalty.name: Champion Ultimate Waste Penalty
champion_ultimate_waste_penalty.desc: Penalty for champion-targeted Ultimate candidates that meet the default waste check. Higher = saves that Ultimate more. Power unchanged.

lane_opportunity_enemy_limit.name: Lane Opportunity Enemy Limit
lane_opportunity_enemy_limit.desc: Max enemies allowed when checking a lane opportunity. Higher = considers opportunities even with more enemies.

skill_arrival_prediction_margin.name: Skill Arrival Prediction Margin
skill_arrival_prediction_margin.desc: Time margin added when predicting when a skill lands. Higher = larger margin. Not in seconds; skill speed and cooldown unchanged.

nexus_finish_start_range.name: Relic Finish Start Range (%)
nexus_finish_start_range.desc: Pushes to end only if the enemy Relic or last buildings are in this range (100 = game default, about 250000). Higher = goes from farther.

weak_team_finish_caution.name: Weak Team Finish Caution (%)
weak_team_finish_caution.desc: Weaker team = more careful finishing the Relic (100 = game default, up to 1.95x stricter). 0 = tries regardless of ability (0.7.1 style).

enemy_approach_engage_range.name: Enemy Approach Fight Request Range (%)
enemy_approach_engage_range.desc: HP>60%, requests a fight if a seen enemy champion is in range (100 = game default 250000; Epic/Serpen: within 230000). Higher = farther.

pre_gank_enemy_check_range.name: Gank Enemy Check Range (%)
pre_gank_enemy_check_range.desc: Before the gank arrives, engaging is only considered with a seen enemy champion in range (100 = game default 250000). Higher = farther.
